scientific_integrity: All-dimensional assertions follow by explicit moment and radial-coordinate identities, not finite experiments; source statements and novelty comparisons are qualified to what was read. No claims of independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Uniform-volume independent point pairs; finite positive-volume Euclidean convex bodies, integer dimension at least two. The same argument extends to measurable bounded regions star-shaped about their volume centroid when radial moments exist. The identity does not provide statistical estimation or Hausdorff stability. Full text of the 1982 Voss chord-power paper was not inspected, and historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp random-distance kurtosis and an exact radial–covariance defect
